newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern to respond to new CRX bid.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern to respond to new CRX bid.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp expects to respond promptly to CSX Corp's sweetened bid for Conrail Inc, Norfolk spokesman Robert Fort said Thursday.
Fort said Norfolk was considering several options.
Its response "could be as early as within the next few hours, it could be this afternoon, it could be tomorrow, I just don't know," he said.
"I think it will be a rather quick, a rather prompt response to their latest offer," Fort said.
Fort said Norfolk was still studying the new CSX offer, announced today.
He said he did not expect any legal action Thursday in response to the offer.

He criticized the new bid as an attempt to avoid defeat at a now-postponed Conrail shareholder meeting next week. At the meeting, shareholders were to vote on a key provision of the CSX plan to acquire Conrail.
A federal judge on Tuesday ordered Conrail to go ahead with the meeting -- absent a material change in the deal such as a new or higher bid.
Conrail rescheduled the meeting for January 17 in light of the new CSX bid.

Fort said Norfolk had taken several calls from Conrail shareholders angered by an agreement between Conrail and CSX that prohibits Conrail from agreeing to a third party takeover proposal before December 1998.
